Chapter 6758: Ferocious Ocean

Chapter 6758: Ferocious Ocean

“A chasm like the ocean floor, this must be the legendary Ferocious Ocean.” He blurted.

Azure Plain was home to sixty to seventy percent of wild beasts in Beastmaster World. Other places and sects had beasts and powerful ones as well.

The majority of emperor and ancestor beasts were outside of their control, normally only inhabiting in Azure Plain.

Cultivators couldn’t surpass a realm to control a mightier beast. For example, the lord of Venerable Dragon could only sign a pact with a king beast.

After becoming an emperor, he could go to Azure Plain to find a more suitable one. Ferocious Ocean was a famous region in Azure Plain, due to its higher population of emperor and ancestor beasts.

It was elusive and some said that getting there was a matter of fate. The divine beast might be here as well.

Thus, the lord was surprised to see a dried seabed. Where was the rumored Ferocious Ocean?

“Raa!” His daughter climbed on top of a boulder, roaring at the sky.

“Raa!” Other beasts roared back in unison, all heading in her direction. Their auras surged like tidal waves.

Auras replaced water, giving the impression of an ocean being here. The lord felt as if he was stuck on a boat amidst a raging storm.

From a distance, it looked as if great armies were coming from all directions with lightning speed. Deafening roars never ceased.

When the first wave collided with the seabed, it sent up walls of water.

“Boom!” Boundless starlight erupted once she opened her mouth. They surged out and merged with the water waves. This continued several times, causing the waves to sparkle with starlight.

“Rumble!” Her light caused the waves to surge higher, shooting into the air. This scene was magnificent, like blooming fireworks.

The lord was left speechless, unable to fathom such a spectacle. He thought his daughter was just an unfortunate girl with congenital defects. Nevertheless, he still adored her.

Now, the light emanating from her could destroy kingdoms in the blink of an eye. Moreover, she was connected to the legendary ocean.

“So this is Ferocious Ocean...” He murmured.

“Impressive, still a child yet already showing signs of a gluttonous beast’s innate gift.” Li Qiye said.

“There are some differences.” Xiaoyue said.

“Right.” Li Qiye nodded: “A gluttonous beast’s Limitless Devouring can absorb anything but she’s releasing, not devouring.”

“Yes, not part of the pure bloodline.” She said.

“Demon Beast Epoch.” He smiled.

“If it existed, it didn’t intersect with Divine Firmament.” She said.

“The epoch lord of Demon Beast was an ultimate cosmic ancestral dragon. His innate gift was rather interesting.” He said.

“Cosmic ancestral dragon, not part of Divine Firmament.” She frowned and said.

“In terms of purity, yes, but he had the bloodline of a true dragon through atavism.” He said.

“Then it should have been a true dragon, not a cosmic ancestral dragon.” She said with certainty.

“Where did this cosmic ancestral dragon come from then? Was it a continuation of Skykiller True Dragon’s bloodline? Or did Skykiller True Dragon have an illegitimate offspring outside of Divine Firmament?” He chuckled.
